It's "M.S." includes capital M and S but with periods; it's not all caps letters? It's mixed case with periods. Might still be considered all caps? Safer to write "Master of Science". Similarly "Bachelor of Science". Avoid "USA". Also avoid "XYZ Corp". Use a generic company name in normal case like "Tech Solutions". Avoid "ABC Inc". Use "Global Innovations". Ensure no accidental all caps.
